description: POSITION is nullable when either operand is nullable -- both operands were previously ignored entirely

columns.name: pos
columns.note: bio is nullable, so POSITION('x' IN bio) is nullable

name: position_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetXPosition
-- @returns :many
SELECT POSITION('x' IN bio) AS pos FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, bio TEXT)
